name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx reverse proxy with SSL termination and multi-site virtual host management, including host-based firewall hardening via UFW, SSH hardening, Fail2ban intrusion prevention, and kernel-level sysctl security tuning across three SSL-enabled subdomains.

name: cache
description: Dual in-memory caching layer that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same host, with password-authenticated Redis and a post-install config workaround to strip deprecated directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python web application deployment that installs Python, PostgreSQL, clones a FastAPI app from GitHub, sets up a virtual environment, provisions the database, and runs the app as a systemd service via uvicorn.
